<a id="summary"></a>

## Summary

Conversations become first-class indexed content (req-0024..0027): agent and human conversations are stored turn-by-turn, anchored to a repo location, enriched through the EXISTING summarize/embed lanes, and queryable through the standard surface -- semantic search over turns, then a windowed fetch (-10/+20 style) around any hit. Workshop 005 (docs/plans/prd/workshops/005-conversations.md) is AUTHORITATIVE for every design decision: tables, measured turn payload, scope. V1 ships storage, intake surface, an import verb, and the query dims; live capture hooks and rollup summaries are explicitly out.
